changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app_settings ( setting_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, setting_value TEXT NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE trash_entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, original_path TEXT NOT NULL, stored_path TEXT NOT NULL, item_name TEXT NOT NULL, item_type TEXT NOT NULL, size_bytes INTEGER, deleted_at TEXT NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE devices ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, paired_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen_at TEXT )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE device_sessions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE pairing_sessions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, consumed_at TEXT )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE pairing_claims ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, device_name TEXT NOT NULL, pair_token_hash TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE upload_transfers ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, destination_path TEXT NOT NULL, file_name TEXT NOT NULL, expected_bytes INTEGER, transferred_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status TEXT NOT NULL, failure_reason TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_device_sessions_token ON device_sessions(token_hash, expires_at)

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_pairing_claims_status ON pairing_claims(status, created_at)

changeSet.author: droppers
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_upload_transfers_updated_at ON upload_transfers(updated_at DESC)
